主要讨论点：处理日期和时间时，尤其是跨时区场景下的最佳实践和常见问题

不同观点：
• **日本程序员的时区处理习惯**：koito17指出，由于日本只有一个时区，许多日本程序员在处理日期时缺乏时区相关逻辑，经常使用OffsetDateTime而不是UTC，导致一些细微的错误。例如，后端返回UTC+9的时间戳，而前端根据用户本地时间格式化，从而产生不一致。他提到，很多日本服务不考虑海外用户，因此这些问题不会被修复。

• **时区作为时间参考系的问题**：sgentle认为，时间问题源于没有明确的时间参考系。如果日期和时间没有明确其相对的时区，传递给不同时区的用户时会导致混乱。因此，设计时需要明确时间的参考系，避免隐式时区引发的复杂性。

• **使用UTC作为内部表示**：AdieuToLogic和hatthew建议，所有日期计算应使用UTC作为内部表示，只在展示给用户时转换为本地时间，以避免歧义。

• **JavaScript的Date类问题**：多个评论（如gnabgib, svachalek, tobyhinloopen）提到JavaScript内置的Date类处理日期和时间时存在很多问题，建议使用第三方库如Joda或新的Temporal API来简化处理。

• **具体实现建议**：
  ◦ sangeeth96提供了从HTML输入元素获取日期并设置时间为午夜的代码示例，并指出没有"date-local"输入类型可能导致的陷阱。
  ◦ xyzzy9563建议将日期存储为Unix秒，并在浏览器端根据本地时间显示，以避免歧义。

补充讨论：
• **全球化产品的日期处理焦虑**：CuriousRose提到在开发全球化SaaS产品时，对如何正确存储和展示日期感到焦虑，目前使用Postgres的timestampz和Luxon库，但希望找到更多最佳实践来确保正确性。

• **幽默与历史背景**：
  ◦ kayodelycaon引用MDN文档说明JavaScript日期处理的特性，并幽默地提到JavaScript的历史问题。
  ◦ jedimastert通过Tom Scott的视频幽默地表达了处理时间问题的复杂性。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于是否应使用UTC统一处理日期和时间，以及如何在设计中明确时间参考系，避免隐式时区问题。日本程序员的习惯做法在国际化场景中暴露出问题，而全球化产品则需要更严谨的时区处理策略。

总结：讨论围绕日期和时间处理的最佳实践展开，重点是如何在跨时区场景中避免错误和混乱，提出了使用UTC、第三方库、明确时间参考系等多种策略。

44691986.article_content:
published:
2025/07/26
category:
dev
tags:
javascript
,
date
,
timezones
TL;DR:
new Date('2000-01-01') creates a date at midnight UTC, not local time.
In Japan (UTC+9), that means 2000-01-01T09:00:00, so our dashboard filters missed all data created before 9AM.
The Bug
We noticed something strange while fetching data for an admin dashboard:
records created before 9AM were missing!
Our date filters were simple:
<input type="date" />
Which outputs a simple string like
const minDateString = '2000-01-01';
So we wrapped it in a Date constructor and compared it in our filter
new Date(minDate) < item.date && item.date < new Date(maxDate);
How hard can it be, right? Well...
Why It Happened
I knew that
new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')
sets the time to midnight. What I didn’t know was that it sets it to midnight in UTC.
For Japan (UTC+9), that means the Date actually becomes
2000-01-01T09:00:00+09:00
.
So when we said “greater than January 1st”, we really meant “greater than 9AM on January 1st”. Hence, anything created from midnight to 8:59:59 was excluded.
The Fix
Instead of letting new Date() assume UTC, explicitly set it to midnight. (And while we're at it, set the max date range to 1ms before the next day.)
const minDate = new Date(`${minInputDate}T00:00:00`);
const maxDate = new Date(`${maxInputDate}T23:59:59.999`);
Lessons Learned
new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')
→ midnight UTC
Always check how date strings are interpreted when time zones matter.
For filters, prefer constructing with year/month/day explicitly or append a local time.

这篇文章主要讨论了信号处理中的I/Q信号及其在无线通信中的重要性。I/Q信号常被视为进入信号处理领域的“门槛”，因为其概念较为复杂，令许多人望而却步。文章首先比较了音频信号和无线电信号，指出虽然两者都是实数波形，但I/Q处理在无线通信中尤为关键。

文章详细解释了电磁波作为信息载体的作用，描述了正弦波的参数（振幅、角频率、相位移）如何用于编码信息。I/Q信号的复杂性主要源于“相位”概念，包括相位移和相位角的区别。

为了在不干扰的情况下传递更多信息，文章引入了正交性的概念，解释了如何利用正交载波实现多路复用。正交性在数学上类似于线性代数中的垂直关系，是解决波形干扰问题的关键。

文章分为两部分，第一部分探讨I/Q处理在无线系统中的意义，第二部分将其与傅里叶变换这一信号处理的核心工具联系起来。通过这些解释，文章旨在揭开I/Q信号的神秘面纱。

When a new member arrives at the Signal Processing Club, this is what they find at the club gate: I/Q signals. Perhaps a secret plot to keep most people out of the party?
Some return from here to try another area (e.g., machine learning, which pays more and is easier to understand but less interesting than signal processing). Others persist enough to push the gate open for implementation purposes (even a little understanding is sufficient for this task) but never fully grasp the main idea. So what exactly makes this topic so mysterious?
To investigate the answer, we start with an example audio signal drawn in the figure below that displays amplitude versus time for some spoken words.
For a comparison, a radio signal with digital modulation is plotted below.
Clearly, both audio and radio signals are simple real waveforms plotted with time. Why then I/Q processing is not common in traditional audio applications but an integral part of radio communications? For this purpose,
Part 1 delves into the significance of I/Q processing in wireless systems, and
Part 2 broadens the scope, linking the I/Q signals (also known as quadrature signals) to Fourier Transform, the most important tool in all signal processing applications.
Let us start with the nature of an electromagnetic wave.
An Electromagnetic Messenger
Wireless systems employ an electromagnetic wave acting as a carrier of information hidden in the variations of its parameters.
The Sinusoidal Wave
This electromagnetic wave is produced by an oscillator through acceleration and deceleration of charges in the forward and reverse directions. Since the charges primarily oscillate back and forth, the wave exhibits a sinusoidal form.
A reverse process occurs on the receive side. The impinging EM wave influences the electrons in the antenna through its electric and magnetic fields. The acceleration and deceleration of these electrons under the influence of these fields creates a tiny sinusoidal electrical signal.
In signal processing, a pure sinusoidal signal is also known as a
tone
. The title of this article refers to this tone, as we will now see how this simple signal alone leads us towards a deep understanding of I/Q signals now and Fourier Transform later.
The Message
This sinusoidal wave can be written as
\[
x(t) = A \cos (\omega t + \phi)
\]
where
$A$ is the amplitude,
$\omega$ is the angular frequency, and
$\phi$ is the phase shift.
I/Q Signals: Mystery # 1
Much of the confusion behind I/Q signals is hidden underneath the idea of phase. Therefore, instead of simply using the term phase, I will differentiate between the following expressions.
Phase shift: This occurs when the waveform is displaced to the right or left from the zero time reference (not aligned with how the waveform is defined, e.g., with peak of a cosine or zero of a sine).
Phase angle: This is the angle of a complex number in the plane formed by real and imaginary parts (more on this later). A good example of phase angle is the
carrier phase offset
between the Tx and Rx local oscillators.
Are these different versions of phase related to each other? The answer depends on the context and I will use the term phase shift or phase angle in the article for clarity.
Any of the above three parameters of a sinusoid can be altered with time to encode a message. The information in this message can be
user-generated (e.g.,
wireless communications
),
arising from the laws of nature (e.g.,
radar
, astronomy, remote sensing, biomedical), or
both (e.g., navigation and positioning systems,
beamforming
).
To people familiar with signal processing, the logical route from here is to show that the phase shift of the sinusoid can only be measured in two dimensions, not one. But this approach will require the reader to understand orthogonality, which is where we go next.
Are There More Carriers?
In bygone times, messages were delivered either by homing pigeons traveling long distances or by spies arriving on horseback at the gates of a walled city. For obvious reasons, having more messengers was essential for surveillance and governance. Therefore, kingdoms used to rely on flocks of pigeons and networks of spies.
Similarly, the question is how to get more carriers in the case of a sinusoidal wave to deliver more messages. To achieve this goal, there should be no interference among the carriers as a fundamental requirement. However, as shown in the figure below, when two carriers with different amplitudes (or phase shifts or frequencies) combine, they create a wave with an amplitude (or phase shift or frequency) that differs from both of the original carriers. Clearly, two waves cannot coexist without meddling with each other.
To solve this problem, we need to learn about orthogonality.
A Numerical Prism
In mathematics, orthogonality is a concept that generalizes the geometric idea of perpendicularity to linear algebra.

data.title: Microsoft Introduces 'Copilot Mode' in Edge
data.author: Bogdanp
data.article_summary: 微软推出了Edge浏览器中的“Copilot模式”，这是一种利用AI技术革新网页浏览体验的新方式。与传统浏览方式不同，Copilot模式不仅仅打开多个标签页等待用户操作，而是主动预测用户需求，充当协作工具，帮助用户整理信息、比较选项、快速决策，并通过语音导航加速日常任务。用户可以允许Copilot访问所有打开的标签页以获得更好的上下文理解，未来还可以让它访问历史记录和凭据以执行更复杂的任务，如预订服务。该模式旨在减少干扰，保持用户专注，并通过个性化设置确保隐私和安全。Copilot模式现已免费向部分市场开放，用户可选择使用经典模式或尝试这一新体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软的Copilot及相关产品策略

不同观点：
• **nolok**：认为微软的Copilot产品线混乱且性价比低，用户真正需要的是能通过自然语言处理Excel任务的AI工具。现有的AI工具无法满足这一需求，微软花了大量资金却没做出实用的产品。
• **kburman**：批评微软近期的一系列用户不友好行为，如强制使用Edge和暗模式推销，认为微软在透支用户信任以追求短期收益，而不是通过提升产品质量来竞争。
• **elphinstone**：认为微软在推一个没人想要的浏览器功能，且该浏览器本身就没什么人用。
• **rs186**：引用Bloomberg的文章和HN讨论，指出没人想用Copilot，因为其表现不佳。
• **tracker1**：曾喜欢Edge，但因其逐渐加入的广告和营销功能而转回其他浏览器。认为微软在滥用其用户基础，并建议商业软件应考虑为Linux打包。
• **fleebee**：不喜欢Copilot未经提示就主动提供功能，认为这是将AI强加给用户，而不是赋予用户更多权力。
• **donmcronald**：担心Copilot会因为低质量的SEO内容而提供错误信息，AI目前无法有效评估信息来源的可信度。
• **hankman86**：质疑AI浏览器自动化的产品市场适应性，质疑是否有用户需求。
• **asim**：认为未来操作系统应完全基于聊天界面，而不是仅仅改变浏览器。
• **thesdev**：认为如果现有的浏览器模式运行良好，就不需要改变，质疑创新是否必要。
• **TrackerFF**：指出自动化人类在网站上的操作是一个重大挑战，特别是在没有API的情况下，认为Copilot在这方面可能有潜力。
• **rich_sasha**：希望有一个专门为生成Copilot提示而设计的插件，认为创建好的提示很困难。
• **terhechte**：对Copilot的集成表示兴趣，特别是跨标签页的功能，但由于已有OpenAI的类似服务，可能会等待其推出。
• **aussieguy1234**：指出Copilot未对Linux启用。
• **adamrezich**：认为“Copilot”已成为微软新的品牌词汇，被过度使用，削弱了其最初的积极属性。

补充讨论：
• 微软在Copilot及Edge浏览器上的策略引发用户不满，尤其是强制推销和广告问题。
• 用户对AI自动化功能的实际需求和产品市场适应性存在争议。
• 跨平台支持（如Linux）和隐私问题也是讨论的焦点。
• 一些用户对现有产品的不满与期待改进，而另一些用户则对AI驱动的未来产品表示兴趣。

July 28, 2025
Introducing Copilot Mode in Edge: A new way to browse the web
By
Sean Lyndersay
For decades, the way we’ve used browsers has remained linear: open a tab (or 20), search for something, read a page, repeat. It’s a model that’s worked well, but it hasn’t fundamentally changed. Until now. As AI begins to reshape nearly every facet of digital life, we’re witnessing a turning point in how we interact with the web. Now, it’s worth asking: is your browser working for you as much as it should?
This is why today we’re excited to launch
Copilot Mode
, a new experimental mode in Microsoft Edge, and our next step towards building a more powerful way to pilot the web.
With Copilot Mode on, you enable innovative AI features in Edge that enhance your browser. It doesn’t just wait idly for you to click but anticipates what you might want to do next. It doesn’t just give you endless tabs to sift through but works with you as a collaborator that makes sense of it all. It keeps you browsing, cuts through clutter and removes friction to unlock your flow – all built to the highest Microsoft standards of security, privacy and performance trusted by billions of people and businesses worldwide – with you as the user always in control.
When you open a new tab in Edge with Copilot Mode on, you’ll see a clean, streamlined page with a single input box that brings together chat, search and web navigation. Copilot understands your intent and helps you get started faster. Copilot Mode also sees the full picture across your open tabs, and you can even instruct it to handle some tasks. Turn your browser into a tool that helps you compare, decide and get things done with ease. Over time, we will continue to improve and add features to Copilot Mode. And if at any time you prefer today’s classic experience on Edge, you can change this in your browser settings.
Copilot Mode is available for free, for a limited time, starting today in all
Copilot markets
, exclusively on Edge for Windows and Mac.* This is a fully opt-in feature –  be sure to click and try out the latest features. Help us shape the future of AI-powered browsing.
If you’re ready to join us on this journey, head over to
aka.ms/copilot-mode
to try Copilot Mode today.
Browse smarter with multi-tab context
With your permission, you can let Copilot see all your open tabs so it can understand the full context of what you’re exploring online. This means better comparisons, faster decisions and less tab toggling. For example, when researching vacation rentals across multiple sites, chat with Copilot to quickly identify which option is closest to the beach and includes a full kitchen – saving time and reducing friction.
Accelerate everyday tasks with Actions
Starting today, Copilot in Edge supports natural voice navigation. You can speak directly to Copilot about what you’re trying to do – whether it’s locating information on a page, or having Copilot open a few tabs to compare options between products. Just say what you need, and Copilot will help you move faster with less clicking and typing.
Coming soon, you will be able to give Copilot permission to access the additional browser context it needs, such as your history and credentials, to take more advanced and seamless actions – like booking reservations or managing errands on your behalf. Imagine simply asking, “Find me a paddleboard rental near work,” and Copilot not only finds the best option, but checks the weather, makes the booking and even suggests sunscreen or tutorial videos to help you prepare.
Stay focused and in your flow with easier access to Copilot
Bring Copilot into any webpage without losing your place. Whether converting recipe measurements or translating content, Copilot appears in a dynamic pane while keeping the original page visible. It’s perfect to help cut through distractions like pop-ups and long-winded blog posts, and to get straight to the information you need.
Pick up where you left off
Copilot will soon be able to guide you in your tasks and organize your browsing – past and present – into helpful, topic-based journeys. These journeys offer suggestions for what to do next, helping you stay focused and keep projects moving forward. For example, if you’ve been researching how to start an online business, Copilot can recognize that and surface relevant insights like recommending a tutorial to watch as you explore different website-building methods. You will always be in control, with Copilot only able to access your browsing content when you choose to enable it, and with clear visual cues when it is helping in the background. With such a powerful feature, our teams are committed to user privacy and security, and we are taking our time to make sure this is built right.
Our commitment to privacy and security
Your privacy and security continue to be our utmost priority. Microsoft only collects the data needed to improve your experience or that you choose to provide via Personalization settings, s

data.title: USB-C for Lightning iPhones
data.author: colinprince
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一款适用于多种iPhone型号的USB-C保护壳——iPh0n3保护壳。该产品售价为49.90瑞士法郎，目前所有型号均已售罄。用户可以登记邮箱以获取到货通知，需求量大的型号将优先补货。该保护壳支持通过USB-C进行充电和数据传输，兼容无线和MagSafe充电，且增强了磁吸效果。不过，某些需要从手机取电的配件（如有线音频设备、外部存储或显示器）需取下保护壳使用Lightning接口。该产品由瑞士制造，采用坚固的深灰色尼龙12塑料。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一款iPhone保护壳及其相关技术特性的评价和讨论

不同观点：
• 一些用户对保护壳的设计表示赞赏，例如其质感和按钮设计（traspler），但也提到了一些舒适度和耐用性问题，比如连接角会刺痛手掌以及扣具可能容易损坏。

data.title: Canada's Travel Boycott Backfires on Ordinary Canadians
data.author: mikhael
data.article_summary: 加拿大人正感受到国内旅行成本飙升的影响。由于美国旅行禁令，更多人选择国内游，导致航班和酒店需求增加，价格随之上涨。许多人在Reddit上抱怨国内航班和住宿比国际旅行还贵，例如有人发现四口之家的航班费用高达3500美元，而飞欧洲却更便宜。数据显示，酒店价格同比上涨3%，而安大略省一周的小屋租金可达2000至3000美元。政府虽尝试通过"Canada Strong Pass"计划降低价格，但国内旅行对许多人来说仍成为奢侈。高税费和需求增加是价格高昂的主要原因。

主要讨论点：加拿大抵制某些商品的目的和效果

不同观点：

• 观点二：有人认为抵制行动应该直接带来经济上的好处，比如让加拿大人能够以更低的价格购买商品。这种观点关注的是短期内的消费者利益，而非长期的政治或社会影响。

• 观点三：另一种看法是，抵制行动的效果需要从多个维度来衡量，包括对企业声誉的影响、对国际关系的影响等，而不仅仅是看国内价格的变化。[Someone123]可能认为，抵制可以通过影响企业决策，从而带来更广泛的变化。

ID

Dreamstime.com
Canada flag on world map background
More and more Canadians are not going on holiday, neither in the U.S. nor within their own country, this year. Unfortunately,
flights and accommodations have become so expensive that plenty of people can no longer afford a trip with their families
. Several Canadian citizens shared their frustration over the issue in a Reddit post. For instance, user ammit84 wrote:
We were going to go home this summer, but air fare for 4 was around $3,500. That's without a rental and hotel. Driving with young kids is just not in the cards for me. Plus we'd need to take way more time off. It's a ducking crime that I can fly to Europe cheaper than within the country.
Unfortunately, this now seems to be a common problem. User dnav8r pointed out that
air travel is considered a luxury in the country and is taxed as such
.
Users Said
Considering it's considerably cheaper for me to drive from Ontario to Newfoundland than it is to fly, I'd say the cost of domestic travel is a problem.
When was domestic travel ever affordable?
It was and still is cheaper to fly to Hawaii than to Halifax.
Reddit user ms_scorpio75 stated that he first realized how expensive traveling within Canada was when buying a ticket for a 50-minute-long flight connecting Toronto and Montreal, and discovered that the lower price was $300.
It now seems that flying to some destinations in Europe and the Caribbean is cheaper than opting for domestic flights, showing how domestic tourism within the country may be experiencing a crisis.

Canada Domestic Travel Is Getting Too Expensive
According to
an article
published by CBC,
the average daily rate for hotel rooms in Canada has increased by 3% this June compared to last year.
This is equal to about $7 per night. While this may not seem much, considering people usually spend several nights in hotels during their vacation and may have to book more than one room, prices can skyrocket quickly.
Last-minute accommodations are also significantly more expensive. According to research carried out by CBC,
a week-long cottage rental in southern Ontario for August costs at least $2,000, with average prices around $3,000
. Some cities can be even more expensive, such
as Vancouver, where costs are now skyrocketing
. Domestic flights are also incredibly costly, mostly due to taxes and federal airport fees.

Of course, traveling within Canada has never been cheap. However, there is a main reason why prices are so expensive now, and the U.S. travel boycott may have something to do with it. The reasoning behind this shift is pretty straightforward.
As demand goes up, so do prices.

data.title: Webflow Down for >31 Hours
data.author: philip1209
data.article_summary: 这篇文章是Webflow的服务通知说明，用户可以订阅电子邮件或短信以获取事件通知。页面提供了全球多个国家的手机区号选项，用户需要输入电子邮件和一次性验证码（OTP）进行验证。此外，用户还可以通过Slack获取事件更新，或使用webhook接收特定事件通知。页面还提到当前服务中断问题，影响控制面板、应用程序及部分表单提交，团队正在密切监控并预计12小时内提供更新。订阅需同意相关隐私政策和服务条款。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对Webflow长时间宕机的技术问题及其背后的原因分析

不同观点：
• [技术债务和架构问题] stackskipton和mattbillenstein认为，长时间的宕机可能是由于技术债务积累和系统架构不良导致的。stackskipton特别指出，缺乏良好的回滚机制可能是问题的一部分，而mattbillenstein则强调这种长时间的宕机通常意味着系统架构存在缺陷。

• [管理层责任] acedTrex将问题归因于高层管理决策，认为过度施压和忽视工程师的维护建议是导致问题的主要原因。该评论暗示管理层的优先级和决策对技术问题有直接影响。

• [同情技术人员] nusl、willejs、sangeeth96和dangoodmanUT对正在处理问题的技术人员表示同情，认为他们正在经历非常艰难的时刻，并希望他们能解决问题并减轻压力。

• [质疑公司生存能力] plutaniano对公司是否能生存到发布事后分析表示怀疑，暗示长时间的宕机可能对公司业务产生严重影响。

• [对平台生存和盈利能力的质疑] betaby对WordPress类平台在2025年是否还能保持盈利表示惊讶，质疑这些平台的商业模式和长期生存能力。

• [幽默和调侃] chupchap以"带回Failwhale"（Twitter早期宕机时常用的标志）来幽默地表达对宕机事件的看法。Marciplan则以轻松的语气表示技术人员正在"vibe coding"修复问题。

补充讨论：
• [对事后分析的期待] bravesoul2和sangeeth96表示希望看到事后分析，以便从中学习。bravesoul2还提到如果涉及数据丢失，问题可能更复杂。

• [CEO声明] wavemode提供了CEO声明链接，供大家参考，引导讨论向管理层回应方向发展。

• [灾难处理能力] wewewedxfgdf指出，公司通常在灾难发生后才能提高处理灾难的能力，暗示这次宕机事件可能为公司提供了宝贵的经验。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于问题的根本原因：是技术债务和管理问题（如系统架构缺陷和决策失误），还是执行和处理问题（如缺乏回滚机制和灾难应对能力）。各方对此有不同看法，但普遍认同长时间宕机对公司和技术团队都是严峻挑战。

44728554.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对Webflow长时间宕机的技术问题及其背后的原因分析

不同观点：
• [技术债务和架构问题] stackskipton和mattbillenstein认为，长时间的宕机可能是由于技术债务积累和系统架构不良导致的。stackskipton特别指出，缺乏良好的回滚机制可能是问题的一部分，而mattbillenstein则强调这种长时间的宕机通常意味着系统架构存在缺陷。

• [管理层责任] acedTrex将问题归因于高层管理决策，认为过度施压和忽视工程师的维护建议是导致问题的主要原因。该评论暗示管理层的优先级和决策对技术问题有直接影响。

• [同情技术人员] nusl、willejs、sangeeth96和dangoodmanUT对正在处理问题的技术人员表示同情，认为他们正在经历非常艰难的时刻，并希望他们能解决问题并减轻压力。

• [质疑公司生存能力] plutaniano对公司是否能生存到发布事后分析表示怀疑，暗示长时间的宕机可能对公司业务产生严重影响。

• [对平台生存和盈利能力的质疑] betaby对WordPress类平台在2025年是否还能保持盈利表示惊讶，质疑这些平台的商业模式和长期生存能力。

• [幽默和调侃] chupchap以"带回Failwhale"（Twitter早期宕机时常用的标志）来幽默地表达对宕机事件的看法。Marciplan则以轻松的语气表示技术人员正在"vibe coding"修复问题。

补充讨论：
• [对事后分析的期待] bravesoul2和sangeeth96表示希望看到事后分析，以便从中学习。bravesoul2还提到如果涉及数据丢失，问题可能更复杂。

• [CEO声明] wavemode提供了CEO声明链接，供大家参考，引导讨论向管理层回应方向发展。

• [灾难处理能力] wewewedxfgdf指出，公司通常在灾难发生后才能提高处理灾难的能力，暗示这次宕机事件可能为公司提供了宝贵的经验。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于问题的根本原因：是技术债务和管理问题（如系统架构缺陷和决策失误），还是执行和处理问题（如缺乏回滚机制和灾难应对能力）。各方对此有不同看法，但普遍认同长时间宕机对公司和技术团队都是严峻挑战。

data.title: Dropbox Passwords discontinuation
data.author: h1fra
data.article_summary: Dropbox Passwords sera supprimé le 28 octobre 2025, dans le cadre de la concentration de Dropbox sur d'autres fonctionnalités. À partir du 28 août 2025, l'accès sera limité à la consultation seule, et à partir du 11 septembre 2025, l'application mobile cessera de fonctionner. Les utilisateurs doivent exporter leurs mots de passe avant le 28 octobre 2025, sous peine de perte définitive des données. Dropbox recommande l'utilisation de 1Password pour transférer les informations. Les administrateurs doivent s'assurer que chaque membre de l'équipe exporte ses données. Après la date limite, toutes les données seront supprimées définitivement et de manière sécurisée.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Dropbox停止密码管理器服务引发的不同用户反应和观点

不同观点：

• [stmw] 认为从战略角度看，Dropbox停止密码管理器服务是合理的，因为维护密码管理器的技术难度高且如果用户使用率低，继续维护成本高昂。
• [qnleigh] 对仅提前三个月通知用户删除数据表示不满，认为对于不常使用或有特殊情况的用户来说，这段时间不够充分。
• [ildon] 对Dropbox的未来表示担忧，认为其产品线单一且缺乏竞争力，尤其在与Google和Microsoft的竞争中处于劣势，并建议Dropbox进行大胆的收购和品牌重塑。

• [relyks] 作为密码管理器的忠实用户，对服务停止表示失望。

44727653.article_content:
Interruption de Dropbox Passwords
Mis à jour Jul 29, 2025
person icon
Les informations contenues dans cet article concernent tous les utilisateurs de Dropbox Passwords, sauf indication contraire.
Pourquoi Dropbox Passwords ne sera bientôt plus disponible ?
Dans le cadre de nos efforts pour nous concentrer sur l’amélioration d’autres fonctionnalités de notre produit de base, Dropbox Passwords sera supprimé le 28 octobre 2025.
Nous vous recommandons de transférer vos mots de passe vers une autre application de gestion de mots de passe telle que
1Password
, un gestionnaire de mots de passe hautement fiable et sécurisé.
Quand Dropbox Passwords sera supprimé ?
Dropbox Passwords sera entièrement supprimé le 28 octobre 2025. Les modifications apportées au produit se feront de manière progressive. Les dates clés sont les suivantes :
28/08/25 : Dropbox Passwords sera disponible en lecture seule dans l’application mobile et l’extension de navigateur
. Vous pourrez toujours consulter vos noms d’utilisateur, mots de passe et informations de paiement enregistrés, mais vous ne pourrez plus en ajouter de nouveaux. Par ailleurs, la fonctionnalité de saisie automatique sera désactivée.
11/09/25 : l’application mobile Dropbox Passwords cessera de fonctionner
. Cependant, vous pourrez toujours accéder à vos informations de mots de passe via l’extension de navigateur.
28/10/25 : Dropbox Passwords sera entièrement supprimé
. Vous ne pourrez plus accéder aux noms d’utilisateur, mots de passe et informations de paiement enregistrés, ni en ajouter de nouveaux. Ces informations seront supprimées de manière permanente et sécurisée de nos serveurs. La fonctionnalité de surveillance du dark web sera supprimée.
Comment exporter mes données Dropbox Passwords ?
Il existe plusieurs façons d’exporter les mots de passe stockés dans Dropbox Passwords vers d’autres gestionnaires de mots de passe. Nous vous recommandons d’utiliser
1Password
pour importer facilement vos informations de mot de passe et protéger vos comptes à l’avenir.
warning icon
Assurez-vous d’exporter vos mots de passe avant le 28 octobre 2025, sinon vous perdrez l’accès à vos données Dropbox Passwords.
Vous pouvez exporter tous les identifiants de connexion et cartes de paiement de votre compte depuis Dropbox Passwords sous forme de fichier CSV. Pour une expérience optimale, nous vous recommandons d’utiliser l’extension de navigateur. Pour créer votre fichier CSV, suivez les étapes suivantes :
Ouvrez l’extension de navigateur Dropbox Passwords.
Cliquez sur votre avatar (votre photo de profil ou vos initiales) dans l’angle inférieur gauche.
Cliquez sur
Préférences
.
Cliquez sur l’onglet
Compte
.
Cliquez sur
Exporter
.
Cliquez sur
Exporter
pour confirmer.
Ouvrez l’application mobile Dropbox Passwords.
Appuyez sur
(paramètres).
Appuyez sur
Exporter
.
Appuyez sur
Exporter
pour confirmer.
highlighter icon
Administrateurs
: chaque membre de l’équipe devra effectuer l’action ci-dessus pour exporter ses données de mot de passe. Pour voir quels membres de votre équipe utilisent Dropbox Passwords, accédez à la
page Passwords
dans l’interface d’administration. Si un membre de l’équipe a un score de mot de passe, cela indique qu’il utilise Dropbox Passwords. Si le statut indique Inactif, cela signifie que l’utilisateur n’utilise pas Dropbox Passwords.
Que se passe-t-il si je ne respecte pas la date limite d’exportation ?
Malheureusement, une fois la date de fermeture définitive passée, le 28 octobre 2025, nous ne pourrons plus récupérer vos données. Nous vous encourageons à exporter vos mots de passe dès que possible.
Si vous ou votre équipe avez des questions ou si vous avez besoin d’aide, veuillez contacter votre responsable relation clients (le cas échéant),
l’assistance Dropbox
ou consulter notre
centre d’assistance
.
Que vont devenir les mots de passe stockés ?
Après le 28 octobre 2025, toutes les données Dropbox Passwords seront supprimées de manière permanente et sécurisée.
highlighter icon
Remarque :
Dropbox n’a jamais accès à vos mots de passe en texte brut.
Quels autres gestionnaires de mots de passe recommandez-vous ?
Nous vous recommandons de passer à
1Password
, un gestionnaire de mots de passe hautement fiable et sécurisé.
Comment importer mes données dans 1Password ?
Pour savoir comment importer facilement vos données Dropbox Passwords dans 1Password, consultez le lien suivant :
https://support.1password.com/import-dropbox/
Comment importer mes données vers un autre fournisseur ?
D’autres fournisseurs peuvent avoir besoin d’informations différentes pour importer vos données Dropbox Passwords. Contactez-les après avoir exporté vos données Dropbox Passwords dans un fichier CSV en suivant les
étapes ci-dessus
.
Mes données sont-elles toujours sécurisées pendant la transition ?
Oui. Nous continuerons à respecter les mêmes normes élevées de chiffrement et de sécurité pour protéger vos données pendant cette transition.

data.title: The biggest passenger plane, Airbus A380, keeps breaking down
data.author: jnord
data.article_summary: 文章指出，全球最大的商用客机空客A380在疫情后旅行需求反弹时一度重现辉煌，但由于机龄增长，维护成本不断攀升。自首飞以来的二十年间，该机型面临越来越多的维修和检查要求，包括漏气滑梯、破裂密封件和破裂的起落架轴等问题。自2020年以来，欧洲航空安全局已发布95项适航指令，数量是同期波音大型飞机的两倍。由于新型节能飞机供应不足，使用A380的航空公司不得不继续运营该机型，尽管其复杂的维护需求正考验全球供应链。机械故障导致的延误和调度问题频繁发生，而A380的维修需耗费大量人力和时间。尽管面临挑战，一些航空公司如英国航空计划对A380进行内饰升级，显示将继续使用该机型。

44729180.article_content:
The world's biggest passenger planes keep breaking down
Angus Whitley and Danny Lee / Bloomberg
Mon, 28 Jul 2025, 9:44 am
6 min read
In this article:
AIR.PA
BA
In its youth, the A380 was a triumph of international collaboration, with 4 million parts made by 1,500 companies worldwide
The world’s largest commercial passenger jet, the Airbus A380, enjoyed an unexpected resurgence hauling full loads of passengers when global travel rebounded after the pandemic. But keeping the ageing superjumbo safely airborne is becoming an increasingly expensive headache for airlines.
Two decades after its maiden flight, regulatory bulletins ordering repairs, inspections or replacement parts for the massive four-engined plane are piling up. While some are procedural, such as a demand for timely equipment checks, others are more serious.
Leaking escape slides, cracked seals and a ruptured landing-gear axle feature among 95 airworthiness directives for the A380 listed by the European Union Aviation Safety Agency since January 2020.
That’s about double the number of directives for large Boeing Co aircraft in the same period.
With newer, more fuel-efficient jets in short supply, airlines committed to the twin-deck A380 have little choice but to keep flying it. In its youth, the A380 was a triumph of international collaboration, with 4 million parts made by 1,500 companies worldwide. Now, in old age, the aircraft’s complexity is testing aviation’s fractured supply chains in the post-Covid era.
“The A380 is a complex aeroplane whose scale does make it more demanding to maintain compared to other aircraft,” the European Union Aviation Safety Agency said in a statement. “It is very important for safety that there is no stigma attached to publishing an airworthiness directive -– safety must come first.”
The agency said such directives, which mandate actions to make an aircraft safe, “can vary hugely in scope and urgency.” The volume of airworthiness directives for different planes “is not a good basis for comparison,” EASA said.
Stranded Passengers
However, with the capacity to carry 485 passengers or more, delays caused by mechanical failures can be costly and create a cascade of scheduling headaches. A Qantas Airways Ltd. A380 on the flagship Sydney-London route broke down in Singapore on May 7 with fuel-pump problems. The onward flight to London was pushed back more than 24 hours and passengers accommodated in hotels.
That was at least the second fuel-pump issue to delay QF1 in Singapore since Qantas reactivated its A380s. More recently, Qantas passengers who were due to depart Singapore on July 14 for Sydney on an A380 were delayed for days because of technical difficulties. Plans to retrieve them sooner were complicated by damage to another A380 at Sydney airport, when an aerobridge slammed into one of the engines.
Story Continues
A British Airways A380, G-XLEB, recently spent more than 100 days in Manila. After returning to London Heathrow in mid-June, it flew just seven days of the next 30, according to Flightradar24. Still, IAG SA-owned British Airways from next year will embark on an interior upgrade program, including overhauling A380 cabins, suggesting the airline will keep flying the plane for years.
For airlines using the A380, large-capacity alternatives are scarce. Boeing’s new 777X is years behind schedule and Airbus can’t make long-haul A350s fast enough. Meanwhile, A380 operators are left with an out-of-production superjumbo that will only become more needy and more expensive to run. In online aviation forums, some services are gaining a name for breakdowns, cancellations or overnight delays.
In a statement, Airbus said the A380 “continues to operate scheduled services with a high level of operational reliability, standing at 99% for the global fleet over the past 12 months. Airbus is committed to providing full technical support to customers to ensure that they can optimize operations with their A380 fleets, and this will continue as long as the aircraft remains in service.”
An Airbus A380 airplane during its maiden flight in France in 2005. Photographer: Marc de Tienda/Bloomberg
60,000 Hours
Meanwhile, A380s are taking up space and manpower in workshops around the world, exacerbating a shortage of repair facilities for the wider commercial fleet. A comprehensive check of the massive plane can consume 60,000 hours of labour, according to aircraft repairer Lufthansa Technik.
Qantas is sending some double-deckers to Dresden in Germany to be overhauled; British Airways flies its to Manila for repairs; and Emirates, the world’s biggest operator of A380s, maintains some in China.
Some of the aircraft’s recent faults stem from prolonged periods on the ground during the pandemic, when airlines parked their A380s in the Californian desert, central Spain or the Australian outback.
An airworthiness directive from the European Union Aviation Safety Agency on May 16 ordered emergency inflatable escape slides to be replaced. Glu

data.title: New drug could halt Alzheimer's
data.author: wiry
data.article_summary: Laura Donnelly 报道，一种名为 trontinemab 的新药在阿尔茨海默病治疗方面展现出巨大潜力。临床试验显示，该药物能在28周内清除90%患者大脑中的淀粉样斑块，速度和效果远超现有药物。该药设计上更容易穿过血脑屏障，从而在低剂量下实现高效治疗，且副作用少。目前正在进行18个月、涉及1600名患者的试验，以验证其对记忆和功能的改善效果。此外，研究还将探讨该药物是否可用于无症状人群以预防痴呆。专家认为，若能早期使用，该药物或可阻止症状出现，且由于其安全性高、成本较低，有望成为首个由英国国家健康服务体系（NHS）资助的阿尔茨海默病药物。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：神经刺激技术在治疗阿尔茨海默病及改善老年人记忆中的应用和安全性

不同观点：
• **支持神经刺激技术的观点**：  
  pedalpete 作为开发神经刺激技术的参与者，提供了研究证据支持其观点。他提到其公司开发的技术（https://affectablesleep.com）在健康老年人中改善了淀粉样蛋白反应和记忆，并在轻度至中度阿尔茨海默病患者中增加了睡眠质量。他强调多项研究表明慢波增强技术是安全的，且尚未发现任何负面影响。神经刺激通过触发大脑的保护机制，增加神经元的同步放电（慢波），从而增强大脑的类淋巴系统以清除代谢废物（如淀粉样蛋白、tau蛋白等）。相比复杂的药物相互作用，神经刺激似乎没有这些副作用。

• **提到其他类似技术**：  
  pedalpete 还提到了另一个类似的技术（https://www.cognitotx.com/），该技术使用开放式听觉和视觉刺激，也能在大脑中产生类似的反应。不过，据他所知，这种刺激相当耗人。

补充讨论：
• **对神经刺激技术安全性的争议**：  
  pedalpete 引用的文章指出，药物治疗存在脑肿胀和脑出血的风险，需要严密监控。而神经刺激技术在这方面似乎具有优势，但他也承认需要更多的研究来确认其长期安全性。

• **与其他治疗方法的比较**：  
  pedalpete 强调了神经刺激技术相比药物治疗的潜在优势，尤其是其在安全性方面的表现。药物通常具有复杂的相互作用和副作用，而神经刺激技术在这方面似乎更具吸引力。

• **研究证据的引用**：  
  pedalpete 提供了两个研究链接来支持他的论点，分别是关于神经刺激技术在老年人中的应用及其在阿尔茨海默病患者中改善睡眠的效果。这为他的观点提供了科学依据。

总的来说，评论主要围绕神经刺激技术在治疗阿尔茨海默病及改善老年人记忆中的应用和安全性展开，支持者认为该技术安全有效，并提供了研究证据支持其观点，同时也提到了类似技术的应用和挑战。

Laura Donnelly
Health Editor
28 July 2025 8:33pm BST
A new drug could halt the progression of
Alzheimer’s disease
.
Trials suggest the treatment, called trontinemab, could be the most powerful weapon yet against dementia.
Research will now examine whether the drug should be given to those without any symptoms in order to prevent the disease.
Results presented at the Alzheimer’s Association International Conference in Toronto found the “game-changing” treatment can clear the devastating plaques associated with Alzheimer’s far more rapidly than any current licensed drug.
Nine in 10 patients prescribed trontinemab experienced amyloid clearance within 28 weeks, meaning visible markers of disease had vanished.
Experts hope these changes will be matched by improvements in memory and functioning, with an 18-month trial of 1,600 patients now under way.
Separate research will examine whether the drug could be given to people without any signs of dementia, in the same way that statins are used to ward off heart disease.
On Monday, experts said the findings were “very promising”, suggesting that the drug was much more powerful than existing medications, with far fewer side effects.
Around one million people in the UK suffer from dementia, with Alzheimer’s disease the most common form.
Powerful precise effects at low doses
Trontinemab is one of a class of new medicines aimed at clearing amyloid plaques. The new findings from phase two trials suggest that, in less than seven months, it has outperformed the ability of existing drugs to clear plaques in 18 months.
Experts hope that if given early enough, the drug could save some patients from developing symptoms at all. It has been engineered to more easily cross the blood-brain barrier, meaning it can ensure powerful precise effects at low doses.
The lack of side effects means it could be offered to large populations. This also means it could be offered at a far lower price than current medications, which require intense monitoring, including regular scans.
Experts believe it could become the first Alzheimer’s drug to be funded by the NHS.
Last year, medicines regulators in the UK gave the green light to the
first two treatments found to slow progression of Alzheimer’s disease
.
Both
lecanemab
and
donanemab
use monoclonal antibodies to clear amyloid plaques in Alzheimer’s disease. In trials they have been found to slow decline by 27 per cent and 35 per cent respectively, over 18 months. However, the risk of brain swelling and brain bleeds means they need intense monitoring.
The new drug appears to have a far better safety profile. The phase two trial of 149 patients found less than five per cent of cases suffering amyloid-related imaging abnormalities, and all cases quickly resolved.
It also requires less frequent infusions, with mass trials to examine the impact of giving the drug to patients once a month for six months, then every three months.
Scientists have been intrigued by the promise of trontinemab because of the way it has been designed to be transported across the blood brain-barrier, which normally prevents chemicals in the bloodstream from entering the brain.
‘Game-changing’
Prof Sir John Hardy, the chairman of molecular biology of neurological disease at University College London’s Institute of Neurology said the advance could be “game-changing”.
He told The Telegraph: “This is absolutely great news. It sucks the plaque out of the brain really quickly, much faster than we have seen with lecanemab or donanemab.”
The scientist, who was the first to identify the role of amyloid in the disease, said the drug’s safety profile was a “massive improvement” on the current drugs on the market, raising hopes it could be used both to prevent disease and stop it in its tracks.
He said: “There is no doubt this could be game-changing. We hope that if we can use these drugs to people early, we can halt the progression of disease, even before people have symptoms. Now we need to see the size of the clinical effect.”
Neither of the current drugs have been funded by the NHS as a result of their high costs, much of which stems from the need for intense monitoring, including regular scans.
Prof Hardy said: “These results show it is much faster and safer than previous drugs, which means less monitoring. That brings down the cost significantly, it means fewer MRI scans, so that would surely mean it would get Nice [National Institute of Health and Care Excellence] approval.”

总的来说，评论主要围绕神经刺激技术在治疗阿尔茨海默病及改善老年人记忆中的应用和安全性展开，支持者认为该技术安全有效，并提供了研究证据支持其观点，同时也提到了类似技术的应用和挑战。

Artificial Intelligence (AI) may have elevated the level of convenience in accomplishing some day-to-day tasks, but it has also become the scourge to professional photographers. In the past years, we’ve been seeing examples of wildlife photographs being modified or regenerated by AI and getting posted on social media with incorrect and misleading captions, often generated by AI as well. These used to be straightforward cases of copyright infringement, but there is no clear line when it comes to derivative work, especially when the variation can easily be defined in the image generation prompt.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：YouTube针对未成年人的账号禁令及其影响

不同观点：
• 观点一：该禁令仅限制创建账号，而不禁止观看视频。WantonQuantum指出，这一禁令只是禁止16岁以下的人创建账户，而不是禁止他们观看YouTube上的视频。这意味着未成年人仍然可以访问平台内容，只是无法进行互动（如点赞、评论、订阅）。

• 观点二：关注实际执行和影响。一些用户可能会认为，虽然该禁令在理论上只限制账户创建，但实际操作中可能会对未成年人访问内容产生影响，尤其是那些依赖登录账户才能观看的个性化内容或受年龄限制的内容。

• 观点三：对家长监管的影响。有用户可能认为，这一禁令可能会促使家长更好地监督孩子的网络使用情况，因为孩子在没有账户的情况下可能会受到更多的内容限制。然而，也有观点认为，家长可能需要更多工具和指导来有效管理孩子的在线活动。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于禁令的实际效果和执行细节。一些用户质疑该禁令是否能够真正保护未成年人，还是只是形式上的限制。
• 例子：有用户提到，某些平台的内容过滤和年龄验证机制并不完善，未成年人可能通过虚假信息轻松绕过这些限制。
• 技术实现：讨论中涉及到技术手段在实施此类禁令中的作用，如IP地址追踪、设备识别等，可能对平台的技术能力提出更高要求。

总结来看，评论主要围绕禁令的具体限制范围、实际执行效果以及对家长和未成年人的影响展开讨论，其中争议的焦点在于禁令能否真正起到保护作用。

data.author: dangle1
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论美国制表师短缺的问题，尤其是高档机械表维修技师的匮乏。由于美国制表业的衰落，具备维修和制造机械表技能的工匠数量大幅减少。据美国劳工统计局数据，2023年美国钟表修理师人数较三年前下降了23%。这一情况对新兴的美国手表品牌构成了挑战。尽管如此，机械表再度受到追捧，像J.N. Shapiro这样的公司推出了几乎全美产的高端手表，但仍面临招聘制表师的困难。

为解决这一问题，劳力士在达拉斯开设了一所新学校，专门培训学生维修其品牌的手表，课程为期18个月，免费培训，毕业生年薪可达7.5万至8.5万美元。尽管劳力士的培训计划专注于其自家品牌，独立制表学校则培养全能技师。业内人士认为，未来可能在专业技师和全能表匠之间达到平衡。

(Robert Gauthier / Los Angeles Times)
By

There is a shortage of watchmakers in the U.S., which has vexed upstart American watch brands looking to grow.
Rolex’s new school for watchmakers opened in Dallas last fall and includes 27 students in its inaugural class.
Ever since watches began bringing order to the ephemeral passage of time, they also started doing something else: breaking.
Own one long enough and something will probably go wrong. It’ll run slow. Or fast. Or stop altogether.
Decades ago, watch repair shops across the country were staffed with technicians who could service almost any mechanical timepiece when its intricate innards — tiny gears, wheels and springs — failed. But when the U.S. watchmaking industry declined in the mid-20th century, the number of craftspeople who could fix or fabricate timepieces began dwindling too.
Advertisement
There were
1,880 U.S. watch and clock repairers
in 2023,
down from 2,430
just three years earlier, according to data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
That 23% decline, on top of previous losses, has led some in this niche industry to
label the situation a workforce crisis.
It comes amid renewed interest in mechanical timepieces and a modest rebirth of the American watchmaking industry — despite the omnipresence of cellphones and their effortless timekeeping. Rolex, the Swiss behemoth, alone makes more than
1 million watches a year
.
Who will be able to service all of them as they age? Or make the new ones being dreamed up?
Advertisement
Business
An L.A. watchmaker crafted a $70,000 timepiece. It could revolutionize the U.S. watch industry
With the debut of the Resurgence timepiece, Inglewood-based J.N. Shapiro Watches is realizing founder Joshua Shapiro’s dream of producing a watch almost fully made in America.
May 22, 2023
A dearth of new watchmaking schools — where students learn about repairs, fabrication or both — is central to the problem. After the
closure of several programs
in recent decades, only four full-time, independent watchmaking schools remain in the U.S.
One watch company, Torrance-based J.N. Shapiro Watches — maker of the
$70,000 Resurgence model
— is among the handful of U.S.-based firms that has struggled to hire watchmakers.
Rolex has a solution on the repair side.
In September, Rolex debuted a new watchmaking school in Dallas.
(Tarick Foteh / Rolex Watch USA)
In September, the Geneva-based company debuted a new watchmaking school at the Rolex Watch Training Center in Dallas. The program’s 18-month curriculum is focused on training students to service watches made by the brand. The last six months of schooling include an immersion component in which students repair Rolex timekeepers under the supervision of instructors.
Upon graduation, participants can work for a Rolex-affiliated jeweler or for the company itself. Most of the school’s first class, which graduates next February, have already secured jobs, a Rolex spokesperson said. They can expect annual salaries starting in the range of $75,000 to $85,000, depending on location.
The school is free. The company spokesperson said in a statement that the Dallas program, which welcomes just 27 students per class, represents the company’s “commitment at a larger scale to meet the industry demand.”
Advertisement
Popular Rolex models include a green Submariner dive watch that collectors have nicknamed “the Hulk,” and the GMT-Master II.
(Myung J. Chun / Los Angeles Times)
Rolex’s focus on training watchmakers to work solely on its timepieces differentiates its program from independent schools, which typically teach students how to work on all sorts of watches, turning out graduates with expertise in subjects including micro-mechanics and repairs.
“I think we need a balance of technicians and then more full-service watchmakers,” said Tony Traina, who publishes
Unpolished Watches
, an industry newsletter. “The way in which the profession is evolving right now — it seems like we’re headed in that direction. There are the Shapiros of the world, along with the Rolexes of the world. I think we’ll reach an equilibrium.”
Rolex opened a more traditional watchmaking school in the U.S. in 2001 — the Lititz Watch Technicum in Pennsylvania, but closed it after its final class graduated this month. The Rolex school in Dallas is in high demand, with 400 applicants for its inaugural class and 560 more for the second one starting in September.

data.title: Pseudo, a Common Lisp macro for pseudocode expressions
data.author: reikonomusha
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一个名为`pseudo`的宏，它嵌入到Common Lisp语言中，利用大语言模型（LLM）将伪代码描述转换为s-expression。该宏可在任何需要表达式的地方使用，通过LLM将自然语言描述扩展为实际代码，并考虑了词法环境中的变量和符号等上下文信息。`pseudo`宏提供了多种指令来影响代码生成风格和使用特定宏的偏好。尽管LLM存在速度慢、成本高、生成结果不可控等问题，但该方法充分利用了Lisp的s-expression优势，简化了与解析器和编译器的交互。实现`pseudo`依赖于SBCL和其他一些库，并使用Google的Gemini作为后端。文章提供了相关代码和库的下载链接，并提醒读者不要在生产环境中使用。

44726641.article_content:
I was wondering what it would look like if a large language model
were part of your programming language.  I'm not talking about
calling the model as an API, but rather embedding it as a language
construct.  I came up with this idea as a first cut.
The
pseudo
macro allows you to embed pseudocode
expressions in your Common Lisp code.  It takes a string description
and uses an LLM to expand it into an s-expression.  You can
use
pseudo
anywhere an expression would be
expected.
(defun my-func (a b)
(pseudo "multiply b by factorial of a."))
MY-FUNC
(my-func 5 3)
360
(defun quadratic (a b c)
(let ((d (sqrt (pseudo "compute discriminant of quadratic equation"))))
(values (/ (+ (- b) d) (* 2 a)) (/ (- (- b) d) (* 2 a)))))
QUADRATIC
(quadratic 1 2 -3)
1.0
-3.0
The
pseudo
macro gathers contextual information and
packages it up in a big set of system instructions to the LLM.  The
instructions include
the lexically visible variables in the macro
environment
fbound symbols
bound symbols
overall directives to influence code generation
directives to influence the style of the generated code
(functional vs. imperative)
directives to influence the use of the loop macro (prefer
vs. avoid)
the source code of the file currently being compiled, if there
is one
pseduo
sets the LLM to use a low temperature for more
predictable generation.  It prints the “thinking” of the
LLM.
Lisp is a big win here.  Since Lisp's macro system operates at the
level of s-expressions, it has more contextual information available
to it than a macro system that is just text expansion.  The
s-expression representation means that we don't need to interface
with the language's parser or compiler to operate on the syntax tree
of the code.  Adding
pseudo
to a language like Java
would be a much more significant undertaking.
pseudo
has the usual LLM caveats:
The LLM is slow.
The LLM can be expensive.
The LLM can produce unpredictable and unwanted code.
The LLM can produce incorrect code; the more precise you
are in your pseudocode, the more likely you are to get the results
you want.
You would be absolutely mad to use this in production.
pseudo
has one dependency on SBCL which is a function
to extract the lexically visible variables from the macro
environment.  If you port it to another Common Lisp, you'll want to
provide an equivalent function.
pseudo
was developed using Google's Gemini as the back
end, but there's no reason it couldn't be adapted to use other
LLMs.  To try it out, you'll need the gemini library, available
at
https://github.com/jrm-code-project/gemini
,
and a Google API key.
Download
pseudo
from
https://github.com/jrm-code-project/pseudo
.
You'll also need these dependencies.
alexandria
— available from Quicklisp
cl-json
— available from Quicklisp
dexador
— available from Quicklisp
fold
—
https://github.com/jrm-code-project/fold
function
—
https://github.com/jrm-code-project/function
named-let
—
https://github.com/jrm-code-project/named-let
uiop

data.title: Big Tech Is the Only Winner of the [UK's] Online Safety Act
data.author: sealeck
data.article_summary: 《新政治家》文章讨论了英国《在线安全法》的实施及其影响。该法旨在保护儿童免受网络不良内容影响，要求用户生成内容平台进行年龄验证，尤其是色情网站。然而，副作用是一些无害的小型网站因高昂的年龄验证成本面临关闭，如"仓鼠论坛"。而大公司如Meta却能轻松应对，吸引更多用户，进一步巩固其垄断地位。文章批评该法未能解决科技巨头带来的深层问题，如算法导致的网络成瘾和隐私侵害，建议将年龄验证责任转给宽带提供商，并考虑打破科技垄断。最终，文章呼吁政府采取更激进的措施，以平衡互联网安全与用户自由。

44728352.article_content:
Illustration by Fabien Gilbert / Ikon Images
Last Friday at 6:32 am, the sitting MP for Lowestoft visited Pornhub. “To continue,” went a pop-up, “we are required to verify that you are 18 or older, in line with the UK Online Safety Act.”
The Act, which came into force last week, was designed to protect children on the internet. Under it, most online services that host user-generated content must conduct risk assessments and take steps to make sure minors do not encounter explicit content. This means all pornography sites must have in place rigorous age-checking procedures. Ofcom
found that
8 per cent of children aged eight to 14 had visited an online pornography site or app over a month-long period.
Fine. But the unintentional by-product is that the most innocuous services might be the worst hit. The Wikimedia Foundation, Wikipedia’s non-profit operator, is
mounting
a legal challenge to the bill, arguing that the changes will compromise the site’s commitment to privacy and freedom of speech. “
This is not good news
,” said the owner of The Hamster Forum, “Home Of All Things Hamstery,” back in March. “I would probably need a lawyer and team of experts to be able to fully comply with everything… I am going to have to close the forum… I’m suggesting everyone joins Instagram and follows our account on Instagram instead.”
The forum’s owner was quoted £2400 a year to use an external age-verification service in compliance with the Act. This is a big chunk of the average part-time webmaster’s income, but nothing to corporate social media executives, who get by on paid advertising and huge initial injections of venture capital. Annual enterprise costs for Persona Identities, the service used by Reddit and LinkedIn, are reported to
start
in the lower six figures.
The only websites with the financial capacity to work around the government’s new regulations are the ones causing the problems in the first place. And now Meta, which already has a monopoly on a number of near-essential online activities (from local sales to university group chats), is reaping the benefits. Thousands of hamster enthusiasts are likely flooding onto Instagram as we speak, ready to be redirected into black holes of miscellaneous “content” they never asked for in the first place. The exact nature of this content is of no corporate concern. The only service rendered is to advertisers, whose pleas are helpfully interspersed between posts and videos. The people running the platform do not care what you logged on for and whether you got it.
Compare this to the beleaguered Hamster Forum. No venture capital is involved – the website was run by passionate hobbyists. They clubbed together with the express purpose of disseminating rodent intel to the people who searched for it. If its users really
do
move over to Instagram, they’ll find their photos and advice trapped behind a login wall, where they will only benefit other net contributors to Zuckerberg’s growing empire. Their pets will make Meta richer – cute videos are an asset if you’re trying to suck consumers into an infinite behavioural loop that only benefits you. Perhaps most unfairly, the forum’s hamster owners will have to live on the terms of people who are totally indifferent to the value of their time and knowledge.
The sad case of London teenager Molly Russell was a major motivator in the writing of the Online Safety Act. Russell saw an algorithmic vortex of disturbing imagery on Instagram and Pinterest before her death in 2017; the vortex existed because tech stakeholders demand infinite growth at any human cost. These are morally corrupting incentives that the Act doesn’t even attempt to address. If Labour mean what they say about online harm, they ought to consider the more radical option: use government policy to dissolve the tech monopolies. Give Britons a chance to eke out an online existence without having to cope with the second-order effects of a for-profit internet – invasive advertising, data collection and addiction-forming “dark patterns.” Let nobody in receipt of public funding post from behind a login wall.
Subscribe to The New Statesman today from only £8.99 per month
Subscribe
Online non-natives have another truth to reckon with: true stewardship is impossible. The government is King Canute and the internet is the unruly tide. Without “user-generated content” there would be no World Wide Web in the first place. If we have to choose between a decentralised internet with user-generated content, or a functionally empty internet with children on it, the answer is obvious: get rid of the children. Take the onus of age verification away from the websites, and hand it to the broadband providers. Open up a competitive market for offline phones. Bring back the CD-ROM, and the paper book. The corporate force needed to keep minors safe online is the same corporate force driving everyone mad.

data.title: Microsoft bans LibreOffice developer's account without warning, rejects appeal
data.author: bundie
data.article_summary: 本文报道了LibreOffice开发者Mike Kaganski的Microsoft账户被无故封锁的事件。他在尝试发送技术邮件时，收到错误提示，随后发现自己的Microsoft账户被禁用。尽管他确信邮件未违反服务协议，但在申诉过程中遭遇了Microsoft糟糕的客服系统，包括无法登录申诉、系统错误以及申诉被无故标记为解决。与此同时，另一位Reddit用户也报告了类似的Microsoft账户被锁且无法恢复的问题，导致其存储在OneDrive上的重要数据无法访问。两起事件均显示出Microsoft在客户支持和账户管理方面的不足。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对大科技公司（如Microsoft、Google等）的不透明处理流程及其对用户数据和账户的影响，社区展开了讨论，涉及信任问题、备份策略以及可能的法律和监管解决方案。

不同观点：
• 一部分人认为，大科技公司的自动化处理流程容易出错，账户被封可能只是系统误报，而非针对特定个人或组织的阴谋。例如，[rossdavidh]提到这可能是使用神经网络等不透明技术导致的误判，并建议用户在使用大科技公司服务时应有自己的本地备份。[gnabgib]同样认为有关Microsoft故意禁止LibreOffice开发者的报道不实，强调Hotmail/Outlook支持虽然不佳，但问题通常能解决。

• 另一部分人强调不应信任大科技公司，建议用户采取更强的备份策略。例如，[tracker1]建议用户至少在本地硬件上保留一份数据备份，并考虑进一步的冗余措施，如VPN远程备份。类似地，[rs186]分享了自己因Google的不当处理而彻底“去Google化”的经历，改用Fastmail作为主要邮箱服务。

• 一些评论者指出这些事件反映了更广泛的法律和监管问题。例如，[cptaj]认为大型平台应受到监管，以确保有适当的法律程序，不能随意关闭账户，并提到反垄断问题。此外，[toomuchtodo]强调了欧洲数字主权的重要性。

• 还有一些评论带有情绪化或讽刺性，如[bozhark]建议采取法律行动，[jackdawipper]和[Simulacra]则直接批评美国大公司行为不当。

补充讨论：
• 隐私和数据安全问题被提及，[roscas]警告用户注意网站嵌入的第三方脚本（如Facebook的跟踪脚本），认为这种广泛的追踪行为需要被制止。

• 部分用户如[jmclnx]则表示对大科技公司的不满，并已采取行动迁移到其他平台，例如从GitHub迁移到GitLab。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于大科技公司账户封禁是否出于技术误报，还是系统性问题。一部分人认为是技术误差，另一部分人则认为这是系统性信任问题，呼吁用户采取自我保护措施或推动监管改革。

44728369.article_content:
Recently, we reported on
LibreOffice, accusing Microsoft of intentionally using complex file formats
as a tactic to lock in users to Microsoft Office, hindering open source alternatives like LibreOffice.
Now, Microsoft has banned LibreOffice developer, Mike Kaganski, from using its services, citing an "activity that violates [its] Services Agreement".
According to Mike,
this happened last Monday when he tried to send a technical email to the LibreOffice dev mailing list, which is a normal part of his routine, but Thunderbird returned an error saying the message couldn't be sent. His account was blocked upon retry, and he found himself completely logged out of his Microsoft account.
Kaganski guessed that his mail and account were getting flagged by a bot or something, since he was quite sure that nothing in the mail violated Microsoft's terms of service.
So he decided to file an appeal, a process which later made him call Redmond "miserably incompetent in IT." The automated system asked for his phone number, which he provided, only to be greeted by a "Try another method" error message.
The problem was that there was no other method offered. He then decided to reach out to Microsoft support directly. After some digging, he found a link to contact the team, and there it was, a button asking him to "Sign in to Contact support".
Now, you might go, "Hold up, how is he supposed to sign in to contact support when his problem is that he can't sign in in the first place?" As Kaganski himself put it:
Yes, you got it right. “Here is a page where we discuss problems signing in. You attempted our FAQ suggestions? You still can’t sign in? No problem! Contact our Support team, and we will solve your problem is a minute! But first, please sign in to continue.”
He eventually got to use his wife's account to file an appeal and finally received a message from support. The instructions inside asked him to go to the sign-in page and, when told the account is blocked, provide a phone number (something he had already tried). Microsoft ignored his detailed report of the failing process, marked his ticket as resolved without any real action, and simply closed it.
He is yet to recover his account. As for the email he was trying to send, he was later able to use Gmail, and it went through with no problem. If you are interested, you can
read the full email for yourself
and see if it violates
Microsoft's services agreement.
Mike's not the only person who's had their account locked recently, with seemingly no way to recover it. On the 17th of last month, Reddit user u/deus03690
shared how Microsoft locked their account,
which, among other things, contained 30 years of "irreplaceable photos and work" on OneDrive.
Their appeal, like Mike's, has been fruitless so far. The user said
Microsoft reached out 10 days later,
asking them to fill out a recovery form and promising to help them "every step of the way," but they haven't heard from the company since.

data.title: YouTube to be included in social media ban for under 16 after exemption reversed
data.author: thomasfromcdnjs
data.article_summary: YouTube将不再被豁免，将被列入针对16岁以下用户的社交媒体禁令中。此前，澳大利亚政府曾考虑豁免YouTube，理由是其教育用途。然而，eSafety专员Julie Inman Grant援引研究指出，YouTube是年轻人最常遭遇网络伤害的平台，建议取消豁免。总理Anthony Albanese表示，不会受社交媒体公司威胁影响。尽管用户无需登录仍可访问大部分内容，但16岁以下用户将被禁止访问年龄限制内容。相关法律细节将于近日提交议会，并于12月生效。YouTube Kids因不具备用户间通讯功能，预计仍将被豁免。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对某项法律的合理性及其社会影响的讨论

不同观点：
• standardUser认为，当前法律与社会实际情况差距过大，可能导致严重的意外后果。尤其是如果年龄限制更低且法律不那么严格，效果可能会更好。法律导致年轻人绕过监管，进行不受控制的互动，从而与成人社会产生隔阂。

• A_D_E_P_T强烈反对不良法律的实施，认为如果大多数民众倾向于规避法律，或法律需要通过极端手段才能严格执行，那么法律本身将失去尊重，社会伦理规则也会受到破坏。这种现象对社会的危害极大。

• WantonQuantum指出，法律仅限制16岁以下用户创建账户，但不限制他们观看YouTube视频。这表明法律的影响可能没有其他人认为的那么广泛。

补充讨论：
• standardUser关注法律对年轻人的实际影响，尤其是他们如何绕过法律并因此与成人社会产生距离。
• A_D_E_P_T从更广泛的角度讨论法律对社会伦理和法律权威的潜在危害。
• WantonQuantum提供了有关法律具体内容的细节，指出法律的实际限制可能较为有限，从而缓解了对法律过于严苛的担忧。

争议焦点：该法律是否合理及其对社会的实际影响。standardUser和A_D_E_P_T都认为法律可能导致负面后果，而WantonQuantum则指出法律的限制可能不如想象的严重。

YouTube to be included in social media ban for under 16s after exemption reversed
By political reporter
Maani Truu
Topic:
Social Media

12 hours ago

YouTube is set to be included in the social media ban for under 16s, after the government previously flagged it could be exempt.
(
ABC News: Ian Cutmore
)
In short:
YouTube will be included in the list of platforms forced to bar users under the age of 16 from having accounts under the government's world-leading social media ban.
The video sharing platform had previously been slated for an exemption on the basis of its educational uses.
What's next?
Details of how the laws will be implemented are set to be presented to parliament on Wednesday, with the ban due to take effect from December.

Children and teenagers will be barred from logging in to YouTube under the
incoming social media ban for under 16s
after the government reversed its plan to grant the video sharing site an exemption.
Rules of how the ban will operate are set to be presented to parliament on Wednesday, including details of the types of platforms that will not be captured, such as those primarily concerned with gaming, messaging, health and education.
It comes days after Google, the parent company of YouTube, threatened legal action if the government scrapped its previously flagged exemption on the basis of the platform's educational uses.
YouTube Kids is expected to still be exempt from the ban, because there is not an ability to communicate with others through the platform.
Over the weekend, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said a decision on whether YouTube would be included was yet to be made — despite the draft rules naming the platform as exempt — and that the government would not be influenced by threats from social media companies.
Commissioner tempers expectations of kids' social media ban
Photo shows
eSafety Commissioner Julie Inman Grant smiles on stage.
Australia's eSafety Commissioner Julie Inman Grant says she is confident the implementation of laws banning young people from social media will be complete by the December deadline, but people should not expect them to work overnight.
"Our government is making it clear — we stand on the side of families," Mr Albanese said in a statement on Tuesday.
"Social media has a social responsibility and there is no doubt that Australian kids are being negatively impacted by online platforms, so I'm calling time on it."
YouTube differs from other popular social media sites in that it doesn't require users to have an account to access most features and young people will still be able to use the site in a logged-out state after the world-leading laws come into force in December.
But including YouTube in the list of social media platforms covered by the ban — which already includes apps like TikTok and Instagram — means under 16s won't be able to access age-restricted content on the video-sharing site.
Confusion over carve out
Former communications minister Michelle Rowland initially flagged that YouTube was likely to be exempt from the laws in November last year.
But the proposed carve out was thrown into question last month when eSafety Commissioner Julie Inman Grant — who is tasked with implementing the laws — wrote to new Communications Minister Anika Wells formally recommending it be scrapped.
She cited eSafety research that found young people used
YouTube more than any other social media platform and it was where they were most likely to experience harm online.
"When we asked where they were experiencing harm and the kinds of harms they were experiencing, the most prevalent place where young Australians experienced harm was on YouTube — almost 37 per cent," Dr Inman Grant said.
"This ranges from misogynistic content to hateful material, to violent fighting videos, online challenges, disordered eating, suicidal ideation."
Government's mixed messaging on YouTube
Photo shows
Woman on computer, generic
The federal government has doubled down on its decision to give YouTube a carve-out from the teen social media ban, despite privately assuring rival platforms that "no final decisions" have been made, the ABC can reveal.
She also argued that YouTube had the characteristics of a platform that should fall under the ban and cautioned against naming specific platforms for carve outs.
The platform's competitors had separately campaigned against its exclusion, accusing the
government of making a "sweetheart deal" in private submissions.
YouTube has previously argued that it is a video streaming platform, rather than a social media site, and therefore should not be captured by the ban, citing evidence that it is widely used in classrooms and by parents.

• A_D_E_P_T强烈反对不良法律的实施，认为如果大多数民众倾向于规避法律，或法律需要通过极端手段才能严格执行，那么法律本身将失去尊重，社会伦理规则也会受到破坏。这种现象对社会的危害极大。

• WantonQuantum指出，法律仅限制16岁以下用户创建账户，但不限制他们观看YouTube视频。这表明法律的影响可能没有其他人认为的那么广泛。

补充讨论：
• standardUser关注法律对年轻人的实际影响，尤其是他们如何绕过法律并因此与成人社会产生距离。
• A_D_E_P_T从更广泛的角度讨论法律对社会伦理和法律权威的潜在危害。
• WantonQuantum提供了有关法律具体内容的细节，指出法律的实际限制可能较为有限，从而缓解了对法律过于严苛的担忧。

争议焦点：该法律是否合理及其对社会的实际影响。standardUser和A_D_E_P_T都认为法律可能导致负面后果，而WantonQuantum则指出法律的限制可能不如想象的严重。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：是否可以通过人为手段模拟重力，以及天气条件对重力模拟的影响

不同观点：
• 观点一：Biercuk认为，人为模拟重力非常困难，除非实际移动大量物质（如一座山）。这一观点强调重力模拟在物理上的限制，意味着仅通过技术手段难以实现对重力的欺骗或操控。

• 观点二：tamimio提出质疑，指出天气条件（如云、暴雨、飓风等）是否也能影响重力或其模拟。这暗示天气现象可能在某种程度上与重力效应相关，或者在讨论重力时需要考虑这些自然因素的影响。

补充讨论：
• tamimio的评论引发了对重力与自然现象（如天气）之间潜在联系的思考，尽管评论中没有明确说明这种联系。
• 争议焦点在于重力模拟的可行性以及是否存在除物质移动之外的其他因素（如天气条件）能够间接影响重力效应。
• Biercuk的观点侧重于技术实现和物理限制，而tamimio的评论则提出了自然界中可能存在的复杂变量。

data.title: Google execs say employees have to 'be more AI-savvy'
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 在最近的全体会议上，谷歌CEO桑达尔·皮查伊表示，公司需要提高生产力以保持竞争力，并强调员工应利用人工智能（AI）提高效率。谷歌正在开发更多工具帮助软件工程师提高工作速度，包括内部AI工具Cider和培训平台“AI Savvy Google”。此外，公司计划在2025年投入850亿美元用于资本支出，以支持AI技术发展。尽管谷歌员工人数较2023年峰值有所下降，但公司正通过裁员和提供买断方案来削减成本。谷歌高管感受到紧迫性，致力于通过AI提高整体生产力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：企业软件工程师是否需要精通AI，以及AI在企业环境中的实际效用和影响。

不同观点：
• sovietmudkipz认为企业软件工程师需要精通AI，以便知道何时部署AI能节省时间。掌握AI工具的有效使用是一项受欢迎的技能，他建议程序员深入了解一个自己熟悉的AI工具栈。

• s1mplicissimus以讽刺的口吻建议用大语言模型（LLMs）取代高管，以确保从技术中获得最大价值，暗示AI有可能在企业高层管理中发挥作用。

• bvan对AI持怀疑态度，基于过去的技术浪潮经验，认为AI的实际效益尚未显现。他持观望态度，等待AI是否能真正带来实际的经济收益。

• blinkbat强烈反对目前企业（如谷歌）大力推广AI的做法，认为AI还不足以取代工程师或显著提高他们的工作效率。他担心开发人员会将未经充分审查的AI生成代码推送到代码库中，增加审查负担和风险，除非工具已大幅领先于市场水平，并且能生成安全可靠的代码。

补充讨论：
• 评论中对AI在企业中的应用前景存在明显分歧，一部分人看好AI的潜力，另一部分人则对其当前的实用性和安全性表示怀疑。
• blinkbat特别提到了AI生成代码的质量问题，指出如果AI生成的代码需要大量人工审查，可能会增加工作负担而不是提高效率。
• bvan的观点反映了技术从业者对新技术的谨慎态度，尤其是基于以往技术泡沫的经验。
• 争议的焦点在于AI是否真的能提高企业软件开发的效率，以及在现有技术水平下是否值得大力推广和依赖AI工具。

In an all-hands meeting last week, Google CEO Sundar Pichai said the company has to "drive higher productivity" to compete.
Pichai said employees should use AI to become more efficient.

Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai during the Google I/O developers conference in Mountain View, California, on May 10, 2023.

Google
executives are pushing employees to act with more urgency in their use of artificial intelligence as the company looks for ways to cut costs.
That was the message at an all-hands meeting last week, featuring CEO
Sundar Pichai
and Brian Saluzzo, who runs the teams building the technical foundation for Google's flagship products.
"Anytime you go through a period of extraordinary investment, you respond by adding a lot of headcount, right?" Pichai said, according to audio obtained by CNBC. "But in this AI moment, I think we have to accomplish more by taking advantage of this transition to drive higher productivity."
In its
earnings report
last week, Alphabet said it plans to spend $85 billion on capital expenditures in 2025, up from the $75 billion it was targeting earlier in the year. It's a theme that's resonating across technology, where internet giants are racing to build costly data centers to run big AI models and workloads while simultaneously cutting expenses elsewhere.
"We are competing with other companies in the world," Pichai said at the meeting. "There will be companies which will become more efficient through this moment in terms of employee productivity, which is why I think it's important to focus on that."
In June,
Amazon
CEO Andy Jassy
said
the company's corporate workforce will shrink in the coming years as it adopts more generative AI tools and agents. In an email to employees, Jassy wrote that employees should learn how to use AI tools and experiment and figure out "how to get more done with scrappier teams."

Microsoft
's president overseeing developer tools, Julia Liuson,
told employees
in June that "using AI is no longer optional."
Shopify
CEO Tobi Lutke
said
in April there's a "fundamental expectation" that employees are using AI in their day-to-day work and, before asking "for more headcount and resources, teams must demonstrate why they cannot get what they want done using AI."
While Alphabet's headcount has been ticking up in recent quarters, it's still below the peak from 2023, when the company had close to 191,000 full-time employees. The number was just over 187,000 at the end of June, according to Alphabet's quarterly
financial filing
last week. Google eliminated about 6% of its workforce in early 2023 and has implemented cuts in various groups since then, offering
buyouts
to employees since the beginning of the year.
"We are going to be going through a period of much higher investment and I think we have to be frugal with our resources, and I would strive to be more productive and efficient as a company," Pichai said, adding that he's "very optimistic" about how Google is doing.
Google declined to comment on the remarks.
'We feel the urgency'
At the meeting, Saluzzo highlighted a number of tools the company is building for software engineers, or SWEs, to help "everybody at Google be more AI-savvy."
"We feel the urgency to really quickly and urgently get AI into more of the coding workflows to address top needs so you see a much more rapid increase in velocity," Saluzzo said.
Saluzzo said Google has a portfolio of AI products available to employees "so folks can go faster." He mentioned an internal site called "AI Savvy Google" which has courses, toolkits and learning sessions, including some for individual product areas.
Google's engineering education team, which develops courses for internal and external use,
partnered with DeepMind on a training called "Building with Gemini" that the company will start promoting soon, Saluzzo said. He also referenced a new internal AI coding tool called Cider that helps software engineers with various aspects of the development process.
Since May, when the company first introduced Cider, 50% of users tap the service on a weekly basis, Saluzzo said. Regarding Google's internal AI tools, Saluzzo said that employees should "expect them to continuously get better" and that "they'll become a pretty integral part of most SWE work."

snapping up
key execs at high-profile startup Windsurf as part of a $2.4 billion deal. Windsurf co-founder and CEO Varun Mohan is joining Google, along with other

data.title: Bun, WASM and Rust Projects with GitHub Actions
data.author: vectronic
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了作者从Deno转向Bun的经历，以及如何结合Rust和WASM项目使用GitHub Actions进行持续集成。作者最初因Deno的单可执行文件、跨平台编译和动态加载功能而选择它，但后来发现Deno不支持外部模块的动态加载。随后，作者转向Bun，解决了远程URL动态加载问题，但Bun不支持从远程URL加载，作者通过编写辅助工具将远程模块本地化。最终，作者实现了高层次的Bun（TypeScript）控制与高效的Rust核心结合，并支持跨平台编译和WASM运行。作者还提供了多个项目模板和GitHub Actions工作流，用于自动化测试、编译、版本控制和发布。此外，作者欢迎反馈和建议以改进该架构。

44726640.article_content:
Jul 29, 2025
Bun, WASM and Rust projects with GitHub Actions
hello.vectronic@gmail.com
BUN
RUST
WASM
Following on from a
previously outlined move to Deno
I’ve now moved to
Bun
😅
The main thing I moved
to
Deno for was a nice way to acheive:
A single executable binary via
Deno Compile
.
Cross platform executables via
cross-compilation support in Deno
.
Ability to dynamically load and run additional logic after installation via Deno’s support for the
Javascript import() function
.
After a while I discovered these items don’t all work well together. It came to light that dynamic loading of modules external to the compiled Deno application was not really supported:
https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/18327
Fair enough, everyone has their priorities…
I then read (but can’t remember where) that Bun
does
support this. 🥳  Ok, game on!
But (there is always a but…) in Bun there is no support for loading from a remote URL:
https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/issues/38
Again, everyone has their priorities… 😣
So in Bun, dynamic imports can reference a local filesystem URL only. However, they CAN be loaded from a compiled executable and they can be loaded from absolute paths or paths relative to the compiled executable. To workaround lack of remote URL support, I wrote a little helper to pull remote modules locally:
https://github.com/flowscripter/dynamic-plugin-framework/blob/main/src/plugin_manager/util/PluginLoader.ts#L26-L47
after which I can import OK here:
https://github.com/flowscripter/dynamic-plugin-framework/blob/main/src/plugin_manager/util/PluginLoader.ts#L85
So we’re good and I am still mostly sane!
So, after previously presenting: “a set of template Deno, Rust and WASM projects on GitHub” in
this post
I am now presenting:
“a set of
template Bun, Rust and WASM projects on GitHub
” together with GitHub
Actions
,
Shared Workflows
and
Template Workflows
for continuous integration.
For my use cases I am looking to achieve:
A scriptable high-level layer (Bun TypeScript) controlling a performant lower-level core (Rust).
A single executable binary which can be cross-compiled.
Ability for the executable to dynamically load and run additional logic after installation via the
Javascript import() function
.
Support for running as much as possible agnostically as an OS process or in a browser runtime with the ability to compile Rust to WASM.
Simple project scaffolding via Bun’s all-in-one approach
Just on that last point… turns out Bun doesn’t do linting or documentation generation
https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/issues/2246
There we are with priorities again… 😣 So for this I am actually still using Deno 🤪 as it “just works” (and seems to handle running on a Bun biased codebase):
deno fmt
deno lint index.ts
deno doc --html index.ts
Features
Before getting into details, some of the feature highlights I’ve managed to achieve are:
A
single executable
available for Linux, MacOS (available via brew) and Windows (available via winget) with Rust FFI and dynamic import.
Roughly the same functionality
running in a browser
with WASM (dynamic import not applicable here).
Instrumented test coverage analysis
Working example projects with GitHub actions for testing, compiling, versioning and releasing for:
Rust
Bun
Rust + Bun via FFI Bindings
Rust + Bun via WASM
Automated PRs, testing, merging, versioning and releasing for internal and 3rd party dependencies
Automatically updated API documentation
Repositories
The GitHub repositories involved in this effort are as follows:
“Application” Projects
flowscripter/template-bun-executable
: Project template for a Bun executable.
flowscripter/template-bun-webapp
: Project template for a Bun based webapp with Bun and Rust based WASM library dependencies.
“Simple Library” Projects
flowscripter/template-bun-library
: Project template for a Bun library.
flowscripter/template-rust-library
: Project template for a Rust library.
“Glue Library” Projects
flowscripter/template-bun-rust-library
: Project template for a Rust library with Bun FFI bindings.
flowscripter/template-bun-wasm-rust-library
: Project template for a Rust library compiled to WASM exposed as a Bun module.
“CI” Projects
flowscripter/.github
: GitHub Actions, Shared Workflows and Workflow Templates
A picture is worth a 1000 words… or maybe its just confusing…
It’s big and complex, but I hope the following describes things visually. It shows the projects (together with their
artifacts and inter-dependencies).
Click on it to open in a larger form.
Flowscripter CI - click to enlarge

主要讨论点：Kubernetes 中的容器和安全方案，特别是关于不可变容器和动态容器镜像的实现

不同观点：
• ahachete 认为，在 StackGres 项目中为 Postgres 扩展所做的工作与此类似，并提到在 Kubecon 上的演讲。然而，他指出该方案并不完美，因为某些 Kubernetes 安全解决方案强制执行不可变容器，一旦代理将任何额外文件拉入容器，就会被标记。他还提到，这种方法使得镜像的安全性（如CVE等）更难推理和保障。为了解决这个问题，他们提出了一种动态容器镜像的解决方案，尽管目前仍需要重启容器，但能保持容器镜像的不可变性。

• melezhik 用 "TL;DR" 简短总结，提出如何通过应用较少的容器设计来反转 k8s 部署，似乎是对讨论内容的一种简化和概括，但没有详细展开具体的实现方法。

data.title: Intel's potential exit from advanced manufacturing- Impact on Oregon
data.author: osnium123
data.article_summary: Intel正在考虑退出先进芯片制造，这一决定可能对其位于俄勒冈州的未来产生影响。作为半导体技术的领导者，Intel在过去25年里在其位于Hillsboro的Ronler Acres研究园区推动了多项技术突破。若停止先进芯片制造，Intel称该决定“可能是不可逆的”，这将对其未来发展方向产生深远影响。俄勒冈州的科研人员一直帮助公司保持技术前沿地位，涉及晶体管设计、半导体材料和制造技术等领域。这一潜在退出引发对公司未来在当地发展的担忧。

data.title: CachyOS: Fast and Customizable Linux Distribution
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: CachyOS是一款基于Arch Linux的快速且可定制的Linux发行版，旨在提供卓越的速度、稳定性和安全性。它采用优化的linux-cachyos内核及先进的BORE调度器，支持x86-64-v3、x86-64-v4和Zen4指令集，并提供LTO、PGO和BOLT优化以提升性能。用户可在安装过程中选择多种桌面环境和窗口管理器，如KDE Plasma、GNOME、i3、Sway等。CachyOS提供两种安装程序：基于Calamares的图形界面安装和命令行界面安装，以满足不同用户的需求。此外，系统还支持多种内核调度器选项，进一步提升交互性能。CachyOS适合追求高效、灵活和快速计算体验的用户。

data.title: Online Ruler – Measuring in inches/centimeters
data.author: artiomyak
data.article_summary:
这款在线尺子适用于任何桌面或移动设备屏幕，自动检测设备并按实际尺寸缩放显示厘米和英寸刻度，无需安装。主要功能包括：

1. **自动设备检测**：自动识别100多种设备，应用正确的PPI，准确显示刻度，设置保存后可跨访问使用。
2. **手动设置屏幕对角线**：若自动检测失败，可手动输入屏幕对角线尺寸或使用信用卡校准，确保精度。
3. **信用卡校准**：通过调整滑块使尺子与信用卡宽度（85.60毫米）匹配，达到精确校准。

支持设备和浏览器广泛，包括苹果、三星、谷歌等品牌。使用时建议将浏览器缩放设为100%，切换设备或显示器时重新校准，并确保JavaScript已启用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对设备校准准确性、默认DPI设置、设备识别问题以及用户体验改进的讨论。

不同观点：
• [rchard2scout] 认为网站校准不准确，手动测量与网站显示的尺寸存在差异（16cm vs 14.3cm）。
• [tzs] 建议校准时将信用卡的一角固定，以便更容易调整其他三个角的位置，从而简化校准过程。
• [brainwad] 指出96dpi作为移动设备的默认值不合适，移动设备通常使用接近160dpi的设置，因为手持设备通常离眼睛较近。
• [LukeShu] 讨论了因X11配置错误导致的DPI问题，以及不同配置下校准结果的差异，并提到许多X11用户的DPI配置错误问题。
• [kasbah] 建议使用`window.devicePixelRatio`代替手动校准，以提高精度和简化操作。
• [gus_massa] 使用信用卡方法进行校准，并建议增加裁切线以便更容易比较，同时建议使用透明规则进行校准。
• [willtemperley] 认为实际尺寸选项对文档编辑器很有用，并提到不同文档编辑器对A4宽度的解释不同。
• [turtlebits] 指出校准模态框在暗模式下不可读，影响用户体验。
• [mkl] 认为对带圆角的屏幕，对角线测量不准确，建议增加宽度和高度校准方法，并使用多点触控进行调整。
• [HPsquared] 质疑设备/浏览器是否报告显示PPI，认为这是Web标准中的一个缺陷。
• [tiffanyh] 提到iPhone 14 Pro被错误识别为iPhone 11，尽管屏幕尺寸相同，但型号识别错误可能导致混淆。
• [wojtek1942] 提到自己的iPhone 15 Pro被误识别为iPhone 16。

补充讨论：
• [gnarlouse] 开玩笑地建议将1英尺改为光在1纳秒内传播的距离，与主要讨论点无直接关系。
• [netfortius] 提供了一个YouTube视频链接，内容可能与讨论主题相关。
• [rahulbisht] 提到在使用27" QHD显示器时，不同缩放比例下校准结果不一致的问题，认为实际尺寸应保持不变。

争议焦点：
• 校准准确性问题：多位用户报告手动测量与网站显示尺寸不一致，表明校准过程存在改进空间。
• 默认DPI设置是否合理：[brainwad] 和 [LukeShu] 都提到默认DPI设置对移动设备和不同配置下的影响，指出标准可能不适合所有设备。
• 设备识别错误：[tiffanyh] 和 [wojtek1942] 提到设备型号识别错误，尽管不影响实际使用，但可能导致用户混淆。

这些讨论反映了用户在使用校准工具时遇到的实际问题，以及对改进校准方法和设备识别精度的需求。

data.title: Show HN: Building a Production Finance Model for Open Source
data.author: positron26
data.article_summary: Positron is developing PrizeForge, an open-source production finance model using Elastic Fund Matching. This model empowers users, allowing programmers to focus on coding rather than fundraising. Funds are matched weekly, creating recurring revenue streams with dynamic thresholds. The process involves enrolling funds, matching them in power-of-two fragments, and triggering payouts when lower levels reach their thresholds. This approach ensures large contributions are supported by matching smaller ones, maintaining equity. PrizeForge aims to fund specific goals like Linux Desktop Environments or Rust language improvements. Initially, funds will improve the platform and support community features. For now, communication relies on third-party platforms like Reddit. The team seeks community involvement and plans to expand beyond software, reinvesting all profits into the company.
